alt: Horizontal bar chart of the share of commuters with negative implied regression weight by occupation group, highest in low-WFH groups: production, transportation & moving, installation & repair.
note: Implied weight of observation i is PERWT_i(D_i − ℓ_i), where ℓ is the fitted value of a linear probability model for WFH with the regression's controls; a commuter with ℓ < 0 enters the comparison with the wrong sign. Groups under 0.5% not shown. In Chapter 4's headline model every fitted value lies between 0 and 1, so no weight is negative.
source: IPUMS USA, ACS 2024 1-year (SAMPLE 202401), analysis/usa/acs/part_2020_2024.parquet; replicate weights REPWTP1–80 from analysis/usa/acs_repwt/part_2020_2024.parquet
subtitle: Share of each occupation group's commuters whose implied weight is negative, occupation + industry + state model
title: Where the linear specification assigns negative weight
x_label: Share of commuters (PERWT-weighted) with negative implied weight
